page: Microsoft Azure E48as_v4 is an EASv4-family memory-optimized virtual machine featuring 48 dedicated vCPUs and 24 physical cores powered by an AMD EPYC 7763 processor. Operating on the x86_64 architecture with a clock speed of 3.525 GHz, this instance is equipped with 384.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It includes 786 GB of local storage and is Premium Storage capable, though it does not feature any dedicated GPUs.

Benchmark results indicate strong CPU and memory performance. The E48as_v4 scores in the top 25% for stress-ng single-core and multi-core CPU tests, as well as the PassMark CPU and memory benchmarks. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression and image processing also rank in the top tier. However, memory bandwidth for large blocks and database operations fall within the average range. Large-scale LLM text generation represents a performance bottleneck, scoring in the bottom 25% with 2.66 tokens per second for a 70B model.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the E48as_v4 offers a dense memory profile relative to its compute resources, making it a viable option for memory-intensive workloads without the premium cost of GPU-accelerated hardware. The instance is well-suited for large relational databases, in-memory caching systems, data analytics, and enterprise applications requiring substantial memory capacity and solid multi-core CPU performance.
